'''2024 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Bochum, Germany, 19–22 September 2024. [[Joe Olson]] defeated [[Emil Wallin]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-09-world-championships-bochum-germany-19-22-september-2024/</ref> Friday team event winners: [[Emil Wallin]] and [[Brian Fred]].<ref name="wrap">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-worlds-wrap-up-joe-olson-earns-third-championship-win/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 19–22 September 2024
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84844 forum]
